answer: The voyage lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the falcon is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the trellis of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
